subject: science
name: Science
title: Pre-K Science: Early Wonder & Nature Exploration
overview: Pre-K Science fosters curiosity and scientific inquiry through hands-on experiments, outdoor observations, and interactive investigations aligned with Next Generation Science Standards (NGSS).
competencies: Ask testable questions and make systematic observations using sensory tools.
Investigate the interactions between physical forces, living organisms, and Earth's atmosphere.
Construct evidence-based explanations for everyday natural phenomena.
Design and evaluate simple solutions to environmental and everyday engineering challenges.

modules.title: The Five Senses & My Body
modules.description: Discovering how our eyes, ears, nose, tongue, and skin help us explore and understand the world.

topics.title: Exploring Sight, Sound & Smell
topics.description: Using sensory observation to classify sounds, scents, and colors in nature.

topics.title: Touch, Taste & Texture
topics.description: Comparing smooth, rough, soft, sweet, and sour sensations safely.

modules.title: Plants, Animals & Living Things
modules.description: Investigating living versus non-living things, plant growth, and animal care.

topics.title: Seeds, Leaves & Plant Growth
topics.description: Planting seeds and observing water, soil, and sunlight in plant life.

topics.title: Animal Friends & Habitats
topics.description: Learning how animals move, eat, and find shelter in nests, dens, and burrows.

modules.title: Weather, Sky & the Seasons
modules.description: Observing sunshine, rain, wind, clouds, and seasonal changes in temperature and clothing.

topics.title: Daily Weather & Clothing
topics.description: Tracking daily weather charts and selecting appropriate seasonal clothing.

topics.title: Sun, Shadows & Day/Night
topics.description: Observing shadows created by the sun and differences between daytime and nighttime.
